summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. furnished a 6-K on September 24, 2026, reporting shareholder approval of a 160-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares at an EGM held September 3, 2026. The consolidation takes effect at 12:01 a.m. Eastern on September 28, 2026, with Nasdaq trading on a post-consolidation basis under symbol DCX. Outstanding shares fall from 375,387,811 Class A and 1,334 Class B to approximately 2,346,174 and 9, respectively. A related capital increase and subsequent reduction preserve par value and authorized capital, with proportionate option and warrant adjustments. This is a routine capital-structure reorganization, not a special situation, though the reverse split signals possible listing-compliance or price-support motives to monitor.
